description: An abstract Spring Boot configuration class that defines beans for setting up various components required by protocol adapters in the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes bean definitions for tracing, Vert.x instance, clients and connections for registration, credentials, tenant, device connection, command handling, health checks, resource limits, and caching.

classes.name: AbstractAdapterConfig
classes.description: An abstract class providing configuration beans for Eclipse Hono protocol adapters in a Spring Boot environment.
